title: HTML Mini Project
description: The HTML Mini Project is a practical activity that allows learners to apply the concepts they have studied throughout the lesson.
A common beginner project is creating a personal portfolio website that includes headings, paragraphs, images, lists, links, and forms.

By completing the project, learners gain hands-on experience in building a complete webpage and develop a deeper understanding of how HTML elements work together to create functional and organized websites.
